add-item.title: Add an item
add-item.description: Start keeping track of something you stock, and when to reorder it.

add-item-here.title: Add an item kept here
add-item-here.description: Add an item that is kept in this location, by name, and when to reorder it.

receive.title: Some came in
receive.description: Record a delivery or restock: how many came in today.

use.title: Some went out
use.description: Record some of an item used or sold today: how many went out.

set-reorder-point.title: Set when to reorder
set-reorder-point.description: Say how low an item may get before it needs restocking.

store-in.title: Keep somewhere
store-in.description: Say where an item is kept, in place of wherever it was.
store-in.fromTheOtherEnd: Keep one of our items here

take-out-of-location.title: Take out of its location
take-out-of-location.description: Say an item is no longer kept where it was.
take-out-of-location.fromTheOtherEnd: Take an item out of here

add-movement.title: Record a movement
add-movement.description: Record stock coming in or going out, before saying which item it was.

attribute-movement.title: Say which item
attribute-movement.description: Say which item a movement was of.
attribute-movement.fromTheOtherEnd: Record a movement against this item

detach-movement.title: Take off its item
detach-movement.description: Take a movement off the item it was recorded against, so it no longer counts.
detach-movement.fromTheOtherEnd: Take a movement off this item

stock-above-reorder-point.title: Nothing runs below its reorder point
stock-above-reorder-point.description: The time to reorder is before the last box goes, not after.

stock-not-negative.title: Stock never goes below none
stock-not-negative.description: Using more than you had means a delivery or a count went unrecorded.
stock-not-negative.says: {name} shows {sum(in('of'), 'change')} in stock — a delivery or a count is missing

grants.describe: Owners and editors may do everything; viewers can look.

document.name: Trip planner
document.description: The days of a trip, where we sleep each night, what we've booked, and who's coming.

day.description: One day of the trip, and whether we spend the night away.

title.description: what to call the day, like "Fri 14 May" or "Day 2"

overnight.label: Staying the night
overnight.description: whether we sleep away this night; false on the day we go home

booking.description: Something reserved or still to reserve: a place to stay, a train, a table, a tour.

covers.description: the days (nights, for a stay) this booking covers

stop.description: A place we mean to go or a thing we mean to do on a given day.

during.description: the day this stop happens on

add-day.title: Add a day
add-day.description: Add a day to the trip; it is assumed we sleep away that night unless you say it is the day home.

go-home.title: Mark as the day home
go-home.description: Say this is the day we travel home, so it needs nowhere to sleep.

stay-over.title: We stay the night
stay-over.description: Say we sleep away on this day's night after all.

book-stay.title: Add a place to stay this night
book-stay.description: Add a hotel, flat or campsite for this day's night, by name, with its cost if you know it.

add-stop-to-day.title: Add a stop to this day
add-stop-to-day.description: Add somewhere to go or something to do on this day.

add-booking.title: Add a booking
add-booking.description: Add something reserved or still to reserve, before deciding which days it covers.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.refusal: {name} was cancelled; add it again if it is back on
confirm.description: Mark a booking as confirmed once it is paid for or guaranteed.

hold.title: Mark as held
hold.refusal: {name} is already further along than held
hold.description: Mark a booking as provisionally held, not yet confirmed.

cancel.title: Cancel
cancel.description: Mark a booking as cancelled; it drops out of view but is not deleted.

set-reference.title: Add the booking reference
set-reference.description: Record the confirmation number, so anyone can find the booking at the desk.

cover-day.title: Covers a day
cover-day.description: Say which day (or night) a booking is for.
cover-day.fromTheOtherEnd: Attach one of our bookings to this day

uncover-day.title: No longer covers a day
uncover-day.description: Take a day off a booking.
uncover-day.fromTheOtherEnd: Detach a booking from this day

include-traveller.title: Put a traveller on it
include-traveller.description: Say a booking is for this traveller.
include-traveller.fromTheOtherEnd: Put them on one of our bookings

exclude-traveller.title: Take a traveller off it
exclude-traveller.description: Say a booking is no longer for this traveller.

add-stop.title: Add a stop
add-stop.description: Add somewhere to go or something to do, before choosing its day.

move-stop.title: Move to a day
move-stop.description: Put a stop on a day, or move it to a different one.
move-stop.fromTheOtherEnd: Move one of our stops to this day

add-traveller.title: Add a traveller
add-traveller.description: Add someone who is coming on the trip.

unschedule-stop.title: Take off its day
unschedule-stop.description: Take a stop off the day it was planned for, leaving it unscheduled.
unschedule-stop.fromTheOtherEnd: Take one of our stops off this day

set-status.title: Set the status
set-status.description: Move it to any status, as a status board does. The named steps stay for what they also record.

every-night-has-a-bed.title: Every night away has somewhere to sleep
every-night-has-a-bed.description: A day we stay away needs a stay booking that is not cancelled.

repairs.label: It's the day we go home

confirmed-has-reference.title: A confirmed booking has its reference
confirmed-has-reference.says: {name} is confirmed but has no booking reference

document.name: Vendor shortlist
document.description: Who we might hire, what they quoted, and who's booked.

category.description: A kind of vendor we need exactly one of, like a venue or a photographer, with what we can spend on it.

budget.description: the most we want to spend on this category

vendor.description: A business we might hire, and where we are with them.

fills.description: the category this vendor would fill

add-category.title: Add a category
add-category.description: Start tracking a kind of vendor you need, optionally with a budget for it.

set-budget.title: Set the budget
set-budget.description: Set or change the most you want to spend on this category.

add-vendor.title: Add a vendor
add-vendor.description: Add a vendor you are considering, before you know which category they fill.

add-to-category.title: Add a vendor to this category
add-to-category.description: Add a vendor you are considering for this category, by name.

set-quote.title: Set the quote
set-quote.description: Record what a vendor quoted, in the app's currency.

mark-contacted.title: Mark as contacted
mark-contacted.refusal: {name} is already past the first conversation
mark-contacted.description: Note that you have reached out to this vendor.

book.title: Book
book.description: Mark a vendor as booked once you have committed to them.

decline.title: Decline
decline.description: Mark a vendor as declined; they drop out of view but are not deleted.

reopen.title: Reopen
reopen.description: Bring a declined vendor back into consideration.

file-under.title: File under a category
file-under.description: Say which category a vendor is for.

unfile.title: Take out of its category
unfile.description: Take a vendor out of the category they were filed under.
unfile.fromTheOtherEnd: Take a vendor out of this category

set-status.title: Set the status
set-status.description: Move it to any status, as a status board does. The named steps stay for what they also record.

one-booked-per-category.title: One vendor booked per category
one-booked-per-category.description: Two booked photographers is a double payment waiting to happen.
one-booked-per-category.says: {name} has more than one vendor booked

booked-needs-quote.title: A booked vendor has a quote
booked-needs-quote.description: Committing without a number is how budgets drift.
booked-needs-quote.says: {name} is booked but has no quote

within-budget.title: Booked vendors fit the category's budget
